answers.question: clean clone overallPassed
answers.answer: pending until final commit and remote clean-clone run

answers.question: hp/maxHp affected
answers.answer: no; hp bypasses equipment and sanitizeUnit keeps base maxHp

answers.question: sanitizeEquipment order
answers.answer: after sanitizeUnits and before operations/theaters; both dangling directions are removed

answers.question: running hashes
answers.answer: equipment mutation is battle_locked; browser and core evidence compare session/deployment/report hashes

answers.question: historical replay
answers.answer: replay reads source.deploymentSnapshot, not current equipment

answers.question: save diff
answers.answer: mount paths are equipment-only; battle/session/ledger/formations are forbidden

answers.question: Stage 9-A values
answers.answer: six theaters and six operations remain configured

answers.question: UI authority
answers.answer: UI calls authoritative getUnitEffectiveStats/canEquipEquipment and uses equipment render signature

answers.question: four gate locations
answers.answer: package posttest/gate, .cnb full gate, workflow Stage9-B steps

browser.fixtureSeedMethod: one valid unit seeded through read-only test state handle; all equipment mount/unmount, dispatch, result and replay actions are production DOM clicks
